en.s: The Battle of the Aegates was a naval battle fought on 10 March 241 BC between the fleets of Carthage and Rome during the First Punic War. It took place among the Aegates Islands, off the western coast of the island of Sicily. The Carthaginians were commanded by Hanno, and the Romans were under the overall authority of Gaius Lutatius Catulus, but Quintus Valerius Falto commanded during the battle.

en.t: The Later Han is founded by Liu Zhiyuan. He declares himself emperor
en.s: Han, known as the Later Han (simplified Chinese: 后汉; traditional Chinese: 後漢; pinyin: Hòu Hàn) in historiography, was a short-lived imperial dynasty of China that existed from 947 to 951. It was the fourth of the Five Dynasties during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period in Chinese history, and the third consecutive Shatuo-led Chinese dynasty, although other sources indicate that the Later Han emperors claimed patrilineal Han ancestry.

en.s: The Battle of Kwiju, also known as the Battle of Kuju, which occurred in 1019, was the major battle during the Third Goryeo–Khitan War (1018-1019), fought between the Khitan-led Liao dynasty of China and the Goryeo dynasty of Korea. After crossing the Amnok River, the Liao dynasty troops invaded the Goryeo dynasty. The Goryeo general Kang Kam-ch'an dammed a stream and released it as the Liao troops were crossing.

zh.s: 九曲之战（又称龟州之战）发生于1019年，是高丽—契丹第三次战争（1018—1019年）中的关键战役，交战双方是由契丹人建立的中国辽朝和高丽王朝。辽军渡过鸭绿江后入侵高丽。高丽将领姜邯赞在一条溪流上筑坝，待辽军渡河时放水冲击。

Edward's army was proceeding northwards to engage Lancaster, having defeated his Marcher Lord allies in Wales. Lancaster fortified the bridge at Burton upon Trent, an important crossing of the River Trent, in an attempt to prevent the King from proceeding.

en.s: Susenyos I (Ge'ez: ሱስንዮስ Sūsinyōs; c. 1571–1575 – 17 September 1632), also known as Susenyos the Catholic, was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1607 to 1632, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty. zh.s: 苏塞尼奥斯一世（吉兹语：ሱስንዮስ Sūsinyōs；约1571—1575年—1632年9月17日），也称天主教徒苏塞尼奥斯，1607年至1632年间统治埃塞俄比亚，是所罗门王朝成员。他的王号是塞尔坦·萨加德和马拉克·萨加德三世。他是阿贝托·法西尔之子、阿贝托·雅各布之孙，也是达维特二世的曾孙。

en.s: The Parliament of England was the legislature of the Kingdom of England from the 13th century until 1707 when it was replaced by the Parliament of Great Britain as a result of the Treaty of Union 1707 which merged the parliament with the Parliament of Scotland. Parliament evolved from the great council of bishops and peers that advised the English monarch.
en.n: Charles I dissolves the Parliament of England, beginning the eleven-year period known as the Personal Rule.

zh.s: 英格兰议会是英格兰王国的立法机构，从13世纪延续到1707年。1707年《1707年联合法案》将英格兰议会与苏格兰议会合并，成立大不列颠议会。英格兰议会由向英格兰君主提供建议的主教和贵族组成的大议会逐渐发展而来。
zh.n: 查理一世解散英格兰议会，开启了后来被称为“个人统治”的十一年时期。

en.t: French "Sun King" Louis XIV begins his personal rule of France after the death of his premier, the Cardinal Mazarin
en.s: Louis XIV (Louis-Dieudonné; 5 September 1638 – 1 September 1715), known as the "Sun King", was King of France from 14 May 1643 until his death in 1715. He is the longest-reigning monarch in history, reigning for 72 years and 110 days. His reign brought about a golden age in French history, marked by a great expansion of the French colonial empire and a flourishing of French culture throughout Europe.

zh.t: 法国“太阳王”路易十四在首相马萨林枢机去世后开始亲自执政
zh.s: 路易十四（路易·迪厄多内；1638年9月5日—1715年9月1日），人称“太阳王”，自1643年5月14日起担任法国国王，直至1715年去世。他是历史上在位时间最长的君主，在位72年零110天。他的统治开启了法国历史上的黄金时代，法国殖民帝国大幅扩张，法国文化也在欧洲蓬勃发展。

en.t: Battle of Sant Esteve d'en Bas
en.s: The Battle of Sant Esteve d'en Bas took place on 10 March 1695 in the Catalan front of the War of the Grand Alliance. It was fought between a column of French regular infantry under Brigadier Urbain Le Clerc de Juigné, governor of the nearby French-occupied Castellfollit de la Roca, and 16 companies of Catalan miquelets and several armed peasants at the orders of Ramon de Sala i Saçala, the veguer of the town of Vic. Juigné's force was in a punitive expedition to burn the village of Sant Esteve d'en Bas, whose inhabitants had refused to pay war contributions to the French army, when it was attacked by the Catalan militia and nearly destroyed in two separate engagements.

zh.t: 圣埃斯特韦登巴斯战役
zh.s: 圣埃斯特韦登巴斯战役于1695年3月10日在大同盟战争的加泰罗尼亚战线发生。法军一支正规步兵纵队由于尔班·勒克莱尔·德·朱伊涅准将率领，他是附近被法军占领的卡斯特尔福利特-德拉罗卡的总督。对阵的是维克地方长官拉蒙·德·萨拉·萨萨拉指挥的16个连的加泰罗尼亚民兵和若干武装农民。圣埃斯特韦登巴斯村民拒向法军缴纳战争摊派款，朱伊涅遂率军前往烧村惩罚，途中遭到加泰罗尼亚民兵袭击，在两次交战中几乎全军覆没。

en.s: The Battle of Helsingborg was the last major engagement of the Great Northern War to take place on Swedish soil. It resulted in a decisive victory of a Swedish force of 14,000 men under the command of Magnus Stenbock against a Danish force of equal strength under the command of Jørgen Rantzau, ensuring that Denmark's final effort to regain the Scanian territories that it had lost to Sweden in 1658 failed. The battle was fought on 10 March 1710 in the province of Scania, just outside the city of Helsingborg, and directly on the Ringstorp heights just north-east of the city.

zh.s: 赫尔辛堡战役是大北方战争中最后一场发生在瑞典本土的主要战斗。马格努斯·斯滕博克率领14,000名瑞典士兵，决定性地击败了约恩·兰曹指挥的同等规模丹麦军队，使丹麦收复1658年割让给瑞典的斯科讷领土的最后一次尝试失败。战斗于1710年3月10日在斯科讷省赫尔辛堡城外、城东北的灵斯托普高地发生。

en.t: Emperor Napoleon I is defeated at the Battle of Laon in France
en.s: The Battle of Laon, fought on March 9–10, 1814, was a pivotal engagement during the waning months of the Napoleonic Wars. Blücher's Prusso-Russian force, occupying a tough defensive position at the town of Laon, repelled attacks by and successfully counterattacked French Emperor Napoleon and his subordinate corps commander, Marshal Marmont. Marmont's actions were severely criticized by Napoleon and almost led to disaster.

zh.s: 荷属东印度皇家陆军（荷兰语：Koninklijk Nederlands Indisch Leger，简称KNIL；印度尼西亚语：Tentara Kerajaan Hindia Belanda）是荷兰王国在其殖民地荷属东印度维持的军队，活动范围包括如今属于印度尼西亚的地区。KNIL的空军部队称为荷属东印度皇家陆军航空队。

en.t: The French Foreign Legion is created by Louis Philippe, the King of France, from the foreign regiments of the Kingdom of France
en.s: The French Foreign Legion (French: Légion étrangère, also known simply as la Légion, 'the Legion') is a corps of the French Army created to allow foreign nationals into French service. The Legion was founded in 1831 and today consists of several specialities, namely infantry, cavalry, engineers, and airborne troops. It formed part of the Armée d'Afrique, French Army units associated with France's colonial project in North Africa, until the end of the Algerian War in 1962.

zh.t: 法国国王路易-菲利普从外国兵团组建法国外国军团
zh.s: 法国外国军团（法语：Légion étrangère，也简称la Légion）是法国陆军的一支部队，成立的目的是让外国人也能加入法国军队。军团于1831年组建，如今设有步兵、骑兵、工兵和空降兵等兵种。1962年阿尔及利亚战争结束前，它一直是“非洲军团”的一部分；“非洲军团”是法国陆军中与法国在北非的殖民活动相关的部队。

en.s: The Battle of Ningpo was fought between British and Chinese Manchu forces in Ningpo (Ningbo), Zhejiang province, China, on 10 March 1842 during the First Opium War (1839–1842). After the British captured Chinhai (Zhenhai) on 10 October 1841, three days later they captured the nearby city of Ningpo unopposed. On 10 March, the Chinese dispatched Manchu Prince Yijing to muster forces and recapture the city but the British repelled their attack. The Chinese forces consisted of Manchu Bannermen. Tricked into thinking the British had abandoned the city, the Chinese rushed in only to find mines laid in the streets.

en.s: The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo officially ended the Mexican–American War (1846–1848). It was signed on the 2nd of February 1848 in the town of Guadalupe Hidalgo. en.s: In the 1856 Chicago mayoral election, Thomas Dyer defeated former mayor Francis Cornwall Sherman. The race was shaped by the divisive national political debate surrounding the issue of slavery, particularly debate surrounding the controversial Kansas–Nebraska Act, and the election was treated by many as a referendum on it. Dyer vocally supported the act, while Sherman stood in opposition to it. The election was held on March 10.

en.s: The Battle of Ségou was a decisive point in the growth of the Toucouleur Empire (1850-1890), which spread throughout the upper Niger River and Senegal River bassins in the late 19th century. It marked the destruction of the last of the Songhay successor states, the beginning of El Hadj Umar Tall's conflict with fellow Fula Jihad leader of Macina, and a Toucouleur movement to the east under pressure from French Colonial expansion in the Senegambia. El Hadj Umar Tall, a Toucouleur conqueror who swept across West Africa from Fouta Djallon, invaded Segou and found an already shaken Bambara Empire.

zh.s: 塞古战役是图克勒尔帝国（1850—1890年）扩张中的关键转折。这个帝国在19世纪后期扩展至尼日尔河和塞内加尔河上游流域。此战标志着最后一个桑海帝国继承政权覆灭，也开启了哈吉·奥马尔·塔尔与马西纳另一位富拉圣战领袖之间的冲突。在法国于塞内冈比亚地区殖民扩张的压力下，图克勒尔势力向东推进。塔尔从富塔贾隆出发，横扫西非；入侵塞古时，他面对的是已经动摇的班巴拉帝国。

en.s: The Battle of Monroe's Crossroads (also known as the Battle of Fayetteville Road, and colloquially in the North as Kilpatrick's Shirttail Skedaddle) was a battle during the Carolinas Campaign of the American Civil War in Cumberland County, North Carolina (now in Hoke County), on the grounds of the present day Fort Bragg Military Reservation. Involving about 4,500 men, it pitted mounted Confederate cavalry against dismounted Union cavalry. It was one of the last all-cavalry battles of the Civil War. The inconclusive fighting lasted for several hours early on the morning of March 10, 1865.

en.s: The Battle of Driefontein on 10 March 1900 followed on the Battle of Poplar Grove in the Second Boer War between the British Empire and the Boer republics, in what is now South Africa. In the first half of 1900, the British made an offensive towards the two Boer republic capitals of Bloemfontein and Pretoria. The Boer forces under the command of Christiaan de Wet were holding a 7-mile (11 km) line covering the approach to Bloemfontein. Lord Roberts subsequently ordered a division under Lieutenant General Thomas Kelly-Kenny to attack the position from the front, while Lieutenant General Charles Tucker's division moved against its left flank.

zh.s: 德里方丹战役于1900年3月10日发生，紧随第二次布尔战争中的白杨林战役，交战双方为大英帝国和布尔共和国，地点在今南非。1900年上半年，英军向两个布尔共和国的首都布隆方丹和比勒陀利亚推进。克里斯蒂安·德韦特指挥的布尔军队守住一条长7英里（11公里）的防线，掩护通往布隆方丹的道路。罗伯茨勋爵随后命令托马斯·凯利-肯尼中将率领一个师正面进攻，查尔斯·塔克中将的师则攻击守军左翼。

en.s: The Courrières mine disaster, Europe's worst mining accident, caused the death of 1,099 miners in Northern France on 10 March 1906. A coal-dust explosion, the cause of which is not known with certainty, devastated a coal mine operated by the Compagnie des mines de houille de Courrières.

en.s: The 1920 South African general election was held for the 134 seats in the House of Assembly of the Union of South Africa, on 10 March 1920. This was for the third Union Parliament. The National Party (NP) won the largest number of seats, but not a majority. The South African Party (SAP) minority government continued in office, with Unionist Party support in Parliament. This was the third successive term of SAP government, but only the second period with General Jan Smuts as Prime Minister. The first SAP premier (General Louis Botha) had died in office in 1919, during the previous Parliament.

zh.s: 民族解放政治委员会（希腊语：Πολιτική Επιτροπή Εθνικής Απελευθέρωσης；转写：Politiki Epitropi Ethnikis Apeleftherosis；简称PEEA），通常称为“山地政府”，是一个以共产党为主导的政府，1944年在希腊成立。它反对雅典由德国控制的合作政府，也反对设在开罗的王室流亡政府。

Bombs, dropped from 279 Boeing B-29 Superfortress heavy bombers, burned out much of eastern Tokyo.

en.t: Mildred Gillars, nicknamed Axis Sally, was convicted of treason for working with the Nazis as a broadcaster
en.s: Mildred Elizabeth Gillars (née Sisk; November 29, 1900 – June 25, 1988) was an American broadcaster employed by Nazi Germany to disseminate Axis propaganda during World War II. Following her capture in post-war Berlin, Gillars became the first woman to be convicted of treason against the United States. In March 1949, she was sentenced to ten to thirty years' imprisonment. Gillars was paroled in 1961.

zh.t: 米尔德里德·吉拉斯被裁定叛国罪成立
zh.s: 1949年3月10日，美国联邦陪审团裁定广播员米尔德里德·吉拉斯犯有叛国罪。她曾在二战期间为纳粹德国播送宣传节目。

en.s: The 1952 Cuban coup d'état took place in Cuba on March 10, 1952, when the Cuban Constitutional Army, led by Fulgencio Batista, intervened in the election that was scheduled to be held on 1 June 1952, staging a coup d'état and establishing a de facto military dictatorship in the country. The coup has been referred to as the Batistazo in Cuban political jargon.

zh.s: 1952年3月10日，富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔率领古巴宪法军发动政变，干预原定6月1日举行的选举，在古巴建立事实上的军事独裁统治。这场政变在古巴政治用语中称为‘巴蒂斯塔政变’（Batistazo）。

en.s: The Air battle over Merklín was an air-to-air engagement between Czechoslovak and USAFE air units over the Czech village of Merklín, in the Bohemian Forest, on 10 March 1953. During the action Czech pilot Jaroslav Šrámek, flying a MiG-15, shot down one of a pair of American F-84E Thunderjets (from 53rd Fighter Bomber Squadron, 36th Fighter-Bomber Wing) which fell 35 kilometres inside the Czechoslovak territory. The American pilot, Lt. Warren G.Brown ejected from the aircraft, which crash-landed in German territory, approximately 35 kilometres (22 mi) from the border, and survived.

zh.s: 1953年3月10日，捷克斯洛伐克空军与美国驻欧空军在波希米亚森林的捷克村庄梅尔克林上空交战。捷克飞行员雅罗斯拉夫·什拉梅克驾驶米格-15战机，击落了两架美国F-84E‘雷电喷气’战机中的一架；这两架飞机隶属第36战斗轰炸机联队第53中队。原文一处称飞机坠落在捷克斯洛伐克境内35公里处，另一处则称坠落在距边境约35公里（22英里）的德国境内，两种说法矛盾。美军飞行员沃伦·G.布朗中尉弹射逃生并幸存。

en.s: The 1959 Tibetan Uprising or 1959 Tibetan Rebellion began on 10 March 1959, when a revolt erupted in Lhasa, the capital of Tibet, which had been under the effective control of the People's Republic of China since the Seventeen Point Agreement in 1951. Although the 14th Dalai Lama's flight occurred in 1959, armed conflict between Tibetan rebels and the Chinese army (PLA) started in 1956 in the Kham and Amdo regions, which had been subjected to socialist reform.

zh.s: 1959年西藏叛乱又称1959年西藏起义，始于3月10日，当时西藏首府拉萨爆发反抗活动。自1951年签订《十七条协议》以来，西藏已处于中华人民共和国的实际控制之下。第十四世达赖喇嘛于1959年出走，但西藏叛乱武装与中国人民解放军的武装冲突，早在1956年就已在实施社会主义改革的康区和安多地区开始。

en.s: The 1959 San Diego mayoral election was held on March 10, 1959, to elect the mayor for San Diego, California, United States. The incumbent mayor, Charles Dail, stood for reelection to a second term. In the primary election, Dail received a majority of the votes and was elected mayor outright with no need for a run-off.

zh.s: 1959年3月10日，加利福尼亚州圣迭戈举行市长选举。现任市长查尔斯·戴尔竞选连任第二个任期，并在初选中获得多数选票，直接当选，无需进行第二轮投票。

en.s: The Waitaki by-election 1962 was a by-election held in the Waitaki electorate in South Canterbury and North Otago during the term of the 33rd New Zealand Parliament, on 10 March 1962. The by-election was caused by the death of incumbent MP Thomas Hayman of the National Party on 2 January 1962. The by-election was won by Alan Dick, also of the National Party.

zh.s: 1962年3月10日，新西兰第33届议会任期内，位于南坎特伯雷和北奥塔哥的怀塔基选区举行补选。国民党现任议员托马斯·海曼于1月2日去世，因此须补选其席位。同属国民党的艾伦·迪克获胜。

en.s: The 1964 New Hampshire Democratic presidential primary was held on March 10, 1964, in New Hampshire as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1964 United States presidential election. Incumbent President Lyndon B. Johnson, who faced no opposition other than write-ins, easily won the primary. He earned the largest percentage of the popular vote for any Democrat in the history of the New Hampshire primary.

zh.t: 1964年新罕布什尔州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1964年新罕布什尔州民主党总统初选于3月10日举行，是民主党为该年美国总统选举挑选候选人的州级提名竞选之一。现任总统林登·B.约翰逊除选民自行填写的其他人选外，没有正式竞争对手，因此轻松获胜。他的得票率创下了民主党人在新罕布什尔州初选中的历史最高纪录。

en.s: The 1964 New Hampshire Republican presidential primary was held on March 10, 1964, in New Hampshire as one of the Republican Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1964 United States presidential election. Former Massachusetts senator, Ambassador to the United Nations, and running mate to Richard Nixon in the 1960 election Henry Cabot Lodge Jr won as a write-in candidate with 36% of the vote.

zh.t: 1964年新罕布什尔州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 1964年新罕布什尔州共和党总统初选于3月10日举行，是共和党为该年美国总统选举挑选候选人的州级提名竞选之一。前马萨诸塞州联邦参议员、曾任美国常驻联合国代表的小亨利·卡伯特·洛奇，凭选民在选票上自行填写其姓名的方式，以36%的得票率获胜。他曾在1960年总统选举中担任理查德·尼克松的竞选搭档。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the United Arab Republic (now Egypt) on 10 March 1964, with a second round on 19 March. At the time the country was a one-party state and all candidates had to be members of the Arab Socialist Union (ASU). A total of 1,750 candidates contested the 350 elected seats. A further ten members were appointed by President Gamal Abdel Nasser.

zh.t: 1964年阿拉伯联合共和国议会选举
zh.s: 1964年3月10日，阿拉伯联合共和国（今埃及）举行议会选举，第二轮投票于3月19日举行。当时该国实行一党制，所有候选人都必须是阿拉伯社会主义联盟成员。共有1,750名候选人角逐350个民选席位，另有10名议员由总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔任命。

en.s: General elections were held in Rwanda on 10 March 1965, the first since independence in 1962. At the time, the country was a one-party state with MDR-Parmehutu as the sole legal party. Its leader, Grégoire Kayibanda, ran unopposed in the country's first election for President. Voter turnout was 87.6%.

zh.s: 卢旺达于1965年3月10日举行大选，这是该国1962年独立后的首次大选。当时卢旺达实行一党制，胡图解放运动党是唯一合法政党。该党领袖格雷瓜尔·卡伊班达在该国首次总统选举中没有对手。投票率为87.6%。

en.t: Military prime minister of South Vietnam Nguyễn Cao Kỳ sacked rival General Nguyễn Chánh Thi, precipitating large-scale civil and military dissension in parts of the nation
en.s: Nguyễn Chánh Thi ([ŋwiəŋ˨˦ c̻an˦ˀ˥ tʰi˧˥]; 23 February 1923 – 23 June 2007) was an officer in the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN). He is best known for being involved in frequent coups in the 1960s and wielding substantial influence as a key member of various juntas that ruled South Vietnam from 1964 until 1966, when he was overpowered by Republic of Vietnam Air Force chief and Prime Minister Nguyễn Cao Kỳ in a power struggle and exiled to the United States.

zh.t: 南越军人总理阮高祺解职对手阮正诗将军，引发部分地区大规模军民动荡
zh.s: 阮正诗（1923年2月23日—2007年6月23日）是越南共和国军的一名军官。他因参与20世纪60年代多次政变而知名，曾是1964年至1966年统治南越的多个军政府中的重要人物。1966年，他在权力斗争中被越南共和国空军司令兼总理阮高祺击败，随后被流放到美国。

en.s: The Battle of Prek Klok II occurred on March 10, 1967, during Operation Junction City when American military forces were conducting a search and destroy operation against the Viet Cong forces in Tay Ninh Province west of the capital of South Vietnam, Saigon. During the course of the operation they had already had a significant engagement in the Battle of Prek Klok I. During the night, Artillery Fire Support Patrol Base II at Prek Klok was attacked by two communist battalions, resulting in a short battle. This was the second major battle of Operation Junction City.

zh.t: 第二次普雷克克洛克战役
zh.s: 第二次普雷克克洛克战役于1967年3月10日发生，是‘交界城行动’的一部分。当时，美军在南越首都西贡以西的西宁省对越共部队开展搜索歼灭行动，此前已在第一次普雷克克洛克战役中发生过一次重要交战。当晚，设于普雷克克洛克的第2炮兵火力支援巡逻基地遭到两个共产党军营级部队袭击，爆发短暂战斗。这是交界城行动中的第二场主要战斗。

en.t: 1971 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill
en.s: The 1971 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill was held on 10 March 1971 to elect the leader of the Liberal Party of Australia and, ex officio, Prime Minister of Australia. Sitting prime minister John Gorton called for a vote of confidence in his leadership, which was tied, prompting Gorton to resign. William McMahon subsequently defeated Billy Snedden for the leadership, and was sworn in as prime minister on the same day.

zh.t: 1971年澳大利亚自由党党魁改选
zh.s: 澳大利亚自由党于1971年3月10日举行党魁改选，当选者也将出任澳大利亚总理。时任总理约翰·戈顿要求就其领导地位进行信任投票，结果票数打平，戈顿因此辞职。威廉·麦克马洪随后击败比利·斯内登当选党魁，并于当天宣誓就任总理。

en.s: General elections were held in India between 1 and 10 March 1971 to elect members of the fifth Lok Sabha. They were the fifth general elections since independence in 1947. Members were elected from 518 single-seat constituencies. Under the leadership of Indira Gandhi, the Indian National Congress (R) led a campaign which focused on reducing poverty and won a landslide victory, overcoming a split in the party and regaining many of the seats lost in the previous election.

zh.s: 印度于1971年3月1日至10日举行第五届人民院选举，这是1947年独立后的第五次全国大选，共有518个单议席选区各选出一名议员。英迪拉·甘地领导的印度国民大会党（R派）以减贫为竞选重点，克服党内分裂的影响，以压倒性优势获胜，并夺回许多在上次选举中失去的席位。

en.s: The Democratic Republic of Vietnam (DRV; Vietnamese: Việt Nam Dân chủ Cộng hòa – VNDCCH) was a country in Southeast Asia from 1945 to 1976, with sovereignty recognized in July 1954, after which it became commonly known as North Vietnam. en.t: Astronomers using NASA's Kuiper Airborne Observatory discovered a faint ring system around Uranus
en.s: The rings of Uranus consist of 13 planetary rings. They are intermediate in complexity between the more extensive set around Saturn and the simpler systems around Jupiter and Neptune. The rings of Uranus were discovered on March 10, 1977, by James L. Elliot, Edward W. Dunham, and Jessica Mink. William Herschel had also reported observing rings in 1789; modern astronomers are divided on whether he could have seen them, as they are very dark and faint.

zh.t: 天文学家借助NASA柯伊伯机载天文台发现天王星周围的微弱环系
zh.s: 天王星有13道行星环，复杂程度介于土星更庞大的环系与木星、海王星较简单的环系之间。詹姆斯·L·埃利奥特、爱德华·W·邓纳姆和杰西卡·明克于1977年3月10日发现天王星环。威廉·赫歇尔也曾报告称在1789年观测到这些环；现代天文学家对他当时是否真的看见了天王星环仍有不同看法，因为这些环颜色很暗、亮度很低。

en.s: Air Ontario Flight 1363 was a scheduled Air Ontario passenger flight which crashed near Dryden, Ontario, Canada, on 10 March 1989 shortly after takeoff from Dryden Regional Airport. The aircraft was a Fokker F28-1000 Fellowship twin jet. It crashed after only 49 seconds because it was not able to attain sufficient altitude to clear the trees beyond the end of the runway, due to a buildup of ice and snow on the wings.

zh.t: 安大略航空1363号航班空难

en.s: The Battle of Bamut was a prolonged military engagement during the First Chechen War that lasted from 10 March 1995 to 24 May 1996. en.t: Republic of the Congo presidential election, 2002
en.s: A presidential election was held in the Republic of the Congo on 10 March 2002. This followed a civil war in 1997, which returned Denis Sassou Nguesso to power, and a subsequent transitional period, in which a new constitution was written and approved by referendum in January 2002. The election lacked meaningful opposition participation, as the main opposition leaders—particularly former President Pascal Lissouba of the Pan-African Union for Social Democracy (UPADS) and former Prime Minister Bernard Kolélas of the Congolese Movement for Democracy and Integral Development (MCDDI)—were in exile, prevented from returning to Congo by legal convictions and sentences that were handed down in absentia.

zh.s: 刚果共和国于2002年3月10日举行总统选举。此前，德尼·萨苏-恩格索通过1997年内战重新掌权，随后进入过渡时期，制定新宪法，并于2002年1月经公投批准。这次选举缺乏有实际影响力的反对派参与。主要反对派领袖，尤其是泛非社会民主联盟的前总统帕斯卡尔·利苏巴，以及刚果民主与全面发展运动的前总理贝尔纳·科莱拉斯，都流亡海外。针对他们作出的缺席定罪和判刑，使他们无法返回刚果。

en.s: The Battle of Yurkud was a three-hour-long military engagement on 10 March 2012 fought between Ethiopian military forces and al-Shabab militants approximately 40 km from the Ethiopian border. According to Ethiopian sources, al-Shabab initiated the engagement with an attack on a military base in Yurkud at around 6 a.m. Fighting continued for three hours before, as locals report, al-Shabab was forced to retreat. The number of dead on either side is not known, with reports varying widely. Al-Shabab claimed to have lost five and killed 73, while one local resident said he saw at least 17 al-Shabab dead and another claimed he had seen six dead Ethiopian soldiers.

zh.s: 2012年3月10日，埃塞俄比亚军队与青年党武装在距埃塞俄比亚边境约40公里的尤尔库德交战，持续约三小时。据埃塞俄比亚方面消息，青年党于早上6时左右袭击当地一座军事基地，打响战斗。当地居民称，交战三小时后青年党被迫撤退。双方死亡人数不详，各方说法差异很大。青年党称己方死亡5人、击毙对方73人；一名居民称看到至少17具青年党成员尸体，另一人则称见到6名埃塞俄比亚士兵的遗体。

en.s: Lockdown (2013) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on March 10, 2013 at the Alamodome in San Antonio, Texas. It was the ninth under the Lockdown chronology and second event in the 2013 TNA PPV schedule. The event broke ground for TNA's largest domestic attendance record of over 7,200 fans, beating their previous record at Slammiversary 2012. From 2005 to 2012, the tradition of Lockdown events featured every match taking place inside a Steel Cage. Beginning with this year's event, Lockdown was modified to featuring standard matches, and cage matches were reserved only for the high profile bouts.

zh.s: 2013年‘封锁’是TNA摔角联盟举办的按次付费职业摔角赛事，于3月10日在得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的阿拉莫穹顶体育馆举行。这是该系列第9届赛事，也是TNA当年第2场按次付费赛事。现场观众超过7,200人，打破2012年周年庆赛事创下的纪录，成为TNA在美国本土观众最多的一场赛事。2005至2012年，‘封锁’的传统是所有比赛都在铁笼内进行。从本届开始，赛事加入普通比赛，只有重要对决保留铁笼形式。

en.s: On March 10, 2026, at Kaseya Center in Miami, Florida, Bam Adebayo scored 83 points for the Miami Heat in a 150–129 win over the Washington Wizards. The performance is the second-highest single-game scoring total in NBA history, behind only Wilt Chamberlain's 100-point game in 1962, and moved Adebayo past Kobe Bryant's 81-point game from 2006.

zh.s: 2026年3月10日，巴姆·阿德巴约在迈阿密佛罗里达州的卡西亚中心为迈阿密热火队拿下83分，帮助球队以150比129击败华盛顿奇才队。这是NBA历史上单场得分第二高的纪录，仅次于威尔特·张伯伦1962年创下的100分；阿德巴约也超过了科比·布莱恩特2006年单场81分的纪录。
